package.author: Tailcall
package.description: An AI pair programmer for Claude, GPT, Grok, Deepseek, Gemini, and 300+ models.

en-US.author: Tailcall
en-US.description: An AI pair programmer for Claude, GPT, Grok, Deepseek, Gemini, and 300+ models.
en-US.longDescription: Forge is an open-source AI pair programmer that runs in the terminal. It connects to Claude, GPT, O Series, Grok, Deepseek, Gemini, and 300+ models to help you write, review, and refactor code.
en-US.name: ForgeCode
en-US.releaseNotes:
Features
- Fix: Claude Opus 5.5 support for claude_code and anthropic providers

Bug Fixes
- Fix(deps): pin html2md to 0.2.15 to fix android build
- Fix: Claude Sonnet 5.5 support for claude_code and anthropic providers
